title: Extensionality along block coordinates
statement: Let $N\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $u,v:\mathbb{Z}\to\{0,1,\text{blank}\}$ be tapes. If $u$ and $v$ agree at every position $(N+1)z+j$, for every $z\in\mathbb{Z}$ and $j\in\{0,\ldots,N\}$, then $u=v$.
hypotheses_covered: $u,v$ are tapes from integers to optional bits
Agreement at every position $(N+1)z+j$ for all integer $z$ and offsets $j\in\{0,\ldots,N\}$
replaced:
Fix $N \in \mathbb{N}$. Two binary tapes $u, v : \mathbb{Z} \to \{0,1\} \cup
\{\text{blank}\}$ that agree at every position of the form $(N+1)z + j$ with
$z \in \mathbb{Z}$ and $j \in \{0,\dots,N\}$ are equal.
